view: Keeps FY27 growth at 3.5–4.5% and the current-account deficit at 0–1% of GDP, but now says inflation returns to target only over the medium term, dropping its earlier June 2027 date.
source: Mettis Global: Half a point, and a longer road to target

view: Wants the SBP to keep policy appropriately tight until inflation is durably back in its target range.
Sees FY27 average inflation of 11–13% and growth possibly below 3.5%, with more rate hikes possible.
source: Express Tribune: More rate hikes may follow

view: Expects an FY27 current-account deficit of $2–3bn, about 0.4–0.6% of GDP.
Expects the FY27 fiscal deficit to widen to 3.6% of GDP, with a primary surplus of 2.0%.
Expects FY27 remittances of $44.7bn, against $41.6bn in FY26.
